claim_tested: The HXXEH(X)E(71-77) rule identifies SDD3's third zinc ligand
key_finding: Spacing His2->Glu3 is 77 (pitrilysin, insulysin), 76 (MPP beta) but 96-97 (PITRM1, AtPreP1, Cym1); SDD3 is 89. The 71-77 window would pick Glu142, which is 21-24 A from the zinc histidines
